snippet.title: A IV Evolution: A Ressha de Ikou 4 [Japanese PlayStation 1] One Hour Of Gameplay
snippet.description:
Enjoy one hour of gameplay from the Japanese PlayStation 1 version of A IV Evolution: A Ressha de Ikou 4. This was a launch game from the December 3rd 1994 launch of the PlayStation 1 in Japan.

NOTE: This is a very historic game. This was the fourth PlayStation game in history. The serial code for this game is SLPS-00004.

This game was published and developed by Artdink. 

Date Recorded: Wednesday, October 23rd 2024
Capture Device: Elgato HD60 S
Software Editor: Pinnacle Studio 24 Ultimate
